trailhead.label: At the waymark-1 signpost below the Rafeil hill in Gufidaun, a short walk up from the fire station and the bus stop

cautions: Two short flights of steps near the start.
About 200 m on the lanes of the upper village, where cars may pass.
A playground lies just off the path: Klausen keeps dogs out of playgrounds.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.At the waymark-1 signpost below the Rafe: Al cartello del segnavia 1 sotto il colle di Rafeil a Gudon, poco sopra la caserma dei vigili del fuoco e la fermata dell’autobus
textIt.Two short flights of steps near the star: Due brevi rampe di scale vicino alla partenza.
textIt.About 200 m on the lanes of the upper vi: Circa 200 m sulle stradine della parte alta del paese, dove possono passare auto.
textIt.A playground lies just off the path: Kla: Un parco giochi è appena fuori dal sentiero: Chiusa vieta ai cani i parchi giochi.
